movement: Any of its seven notes can carry a phrase or end one, and Ri, Ga, Ma and Ni most of all. The higher Dha (D2) comes only in a few phrases rising to Sa; everywhere else the Dha is the lower one (D1). A borrowed note reached from below is touched, not held.
